name: fk-transfer-pricing
description: Apply Falkland Islands transfer pricing under section 156 and Schedule 2A of the Taxes Ordinance 1997 to controlled arrangements in 2026. Use for related-party sales, services, loans, guarantees, management charges, local transactions and cross-border pricing. Tests participation, differences from independent dealings and potential Falkland tax advantage before making an adjustment. Explains the domestic exception, compensating claims and special ring-fence boundaries, with recomputing pricing and decision examples. Does not assume UK small-business exemptions, modern OECD documentation thresholds, a safe-harbour margin, or a country-by-country filing obligation absent local authority. Formal dispute and petroleum valuation work requires specialist advice.
